newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.

text.p: Buying resumed on electronics in late trade on Friday, pushing up Taiwan share prices further higher in the wake of Wall Street's big gains. Brokers said they expected the firming trend to continue.
With 57 minutes left, at 0303 GMT, the index was up 81.73 points or 0.99 percent at 8,341.01.
Turnover was relatively light at T$76 billion.
Taking their cue from Wall Street's financials-led surge, Taiwan financials rose 1.26 percent with China Development up T$1 to T$119.5.
Electronics, which fell in early trade, turned to rise 1.21 percent as market bellwether Taiwan Semiconductor continued to rise, surging T$5 to T$96.
Electronics got off to a slow start because institutional investors dumped semiconductor shares on Thursday, but found upward momentum despite institutional jitters, brokers said.
"Seeing the sound outlook for electronics, bargain hunters keep on entering despite institutions' selling," said United Securities vice-president Lin Long-hsien.
Leading shoemaker Pou Chen rose the daily seven percent limit to T$117 on its ex-bonus issue date.
Lin said the index had found firm support at 8,250 in recent sessions. A firming trend to test 8,500 was seen.
